name: board
title: Permit board
subtitle: Who is inside, what is live, what is isolated and what breaks a rule, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Inside confined spaces now
sections.sql: select permit, asset, asset_name, person, company, to_char(in_at, 'HH24:MI') in_at, minutes_in, coalesce(standby, 'NONE') standby from ptw.inside_now order by in_at

sections.title: Open permits
sections.sql: select code, kind_name kind, area, coalesce(asset, '') asset, task, receiver, company, to_char(valid_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') valid_to, minutes_left, crew_on, inside, case when not isolation_needed then '' when isolation_verified then 'verified' else 'NOT VERIFIED' end isolation, state from ptw.permit_board order by state = 'EXPIRED' desc, valid_to

sections.title: Rule breaches
sections.note: Each rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, ref, subject, detail from ptw.compliance_findings where severity = 'breach' order by rule, ref

sections.title: Isolations in place
sections.sql: select code, asset, asset_name, status, isolator, points || ' of ' || asset_points points_locked, personal_locks_on, coalesce(open_permits, '') open_permits, hours_isolated from ptw.isolation_state where status <> 'removed' order by code

sections.title: Personal locks on
sections.sql: select isolation, asset, person, company, lock_no, hours_on, flag from ptw.locks_on order by flag = '', isolation

name: people
title: People and contractors
subtitle: Tickets, inductions and insurance: what has lapsed and what is about to

sections.title: People on open permits without the ticket their role needs
sections.sql: select permit, role, person, company, ticket, coalesce(expires_on::text, '') expired_on, state from ptw.role_needs where state <> 'ok' order by permit, role

sections.title: Lapsed or lapsing
sections.sql: select person, company, ticket, coalesce(ref, '') ref, expires_on, days_left, state from ptw.ticket_status where state <> 'current' order by days_left nulls first

sections.title: Contractor companies
sections.sql: select code, name, contact, insurance_expires_on insurance_to, prequalified_on, (select count(*) from ptw.people p where p.company_id = c.id and p.active) people from ptw.companies c where kind = 'contractor' order by insurance_expires_on nulls first

name: history
title: The last 90 days
subtitle: Where the isolation hours went, and how permits were closed

sections.title: Isolation hours by asset
sections.note: The assets maintenance keeps going back to.
sections.sql: select asset, name, area, isolations, hours_isolated, permits from ptw.asset_isolation_history where isolations > 0 order by hours_isolated desc

sections.title: Permits closed in the last 30 days
sections.sql: select p.code, k.name kind, p.task, to_char(p.closed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') closed, coalesce(p.handback, '') handback from ptw.permits p join ptw.permit_kinds k on k.code = p.kind where p.status = 'closed' and p.closed_at >= ptw.site_now() - interval '30 days' order by p.closed_at desc

sections.title: Hot work fire watch
sections.sql: select p.code, p.task, (extract(epoch from (p.fire_watch_end_at - p.work_ended_at)) / 60)::int fire_watch_minutes, (select fire_watch_minutes from ptw.settings) site_rule from ptw.permits p where p.kind = 'hot_work' and p.status = 'closed' order by p.closed_at desc
